items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Pearlie Mae was -- so I knew that wasn't going to last long

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, there was a bunch of them. They couldn't -- well, they couldn't cut the mustard, I mean. Bellson was one that did a good job. Well, he knew what he was doing and, naturally, he was looking out for himself, too, he
and Pearlie Mae was -- so I knew that wasn't going to last long, which it didn't. But every now and then he'd go out and help Duke. He helped Duke out when he got a chance.
Well, Louie was very devoted to Duke.
